scope: First of multiple three-pair manual gesture review batches; source geometry untouched
rule: Numbers give proposed pen-down order; each colored path is one continuous proposed stroke; mirror partner reflects the guide; directions are not recovered originals.

groups.name: Outer return + inner rising hook

steps.name: Outer U / return
steps.description: Start high on the left; sweep down through the bottom and curve up the right side.

steps.name: Inner descending hook
steps.description: From the inner upper tip, descend to nearly meet the bottom of stroke 1.

groups.caveat: Trace-derived silhouette; two tentative centerlines, not historical trajectories.

groups.name: Folded upper sweep + separate diagonal

steps.name: Upper folded sweep
steps.description: Begin at upper left, curl right, fold at the corner, then return down-left.

steps.name: Detached lower diagonal
steps.description: Start at the detached mid-right tip and sweep down toward the lower left.

groups.caveat: Candidate follows the recovered v0.16 R3 appearance, not verified original stroke order.

groups.name: Connected upper arch + lower fork

steps.name: Upper arch and underline
steps.description: Arch from the upper left to right, turn and sweep the underline back toward the left.

steps.name: Lower left leg
steps.description: Start from the pointed lower apex and curve left/down into the long hooked leg.

steps.name: Lower right leg
steps.description: Return to the same lower apex and sweep down/right to the shorter leg.

groups.caveat: Respects the accepted arch/underline and pointed two-leg sketch; screenshot paths are outlines, not real original pen directions.

note: Original proposal paths unchanged. Authoritative accepted copy at approved_gestures.json.
